d:
My only real complaint is that the loli's upper body is way too skeletal. Makes her look uncomfortably starved.

But decent first impression by what looks to be a recently new author. Bit too fast paced but that's most Puni Pedo stories. As for the art, the face, the eyes, everything is quite adorable. Just hope this skeletal loli design is just a phase. XD
n: [Manga] [Type Yamada] Watashi-tachi no Koi | Our Love (Digital Puni Pedo! Vol.40) [English] {Mistvern}
